judgments.basis: Token terms and licence (collection documentation); ASC 350-60-15-1(e); ASC 350-30-35-1 to 35-4 useful-life factors; ASC 350-30-35-18 impairment of indefinite-lived intangibles.
judgments.proposedConclusion: Each NFT conveys only ownership of the token and a non-exclusive display licence; no right to goods, services, royalties or other assets. They fail ASC 350-60-15-1(e) (not fungible) and are intangible assets under ASC 350-30 with an indefinite useful life (ASC 350-30-35-4: no legal, contractual or economic limit), so they are carried at cost less impairment and tested under ASC 350-30-35-18.

judgments.basis: ASC 350-30-35-19 compares carrying amount to fair value; ASC 820 principal-market pricing; floor price is the most representative observable input for a unique asset.
judgments.proposedConclusion: The lowest observable floor price for the collection during the period on the principal marketplace, consistent with the practice of testing at the lowest intraday observable price.
